'''Rudy Gobert''' (born June 26, 1992 in [[Saint-Quentin, Aisne]], [[France]]) is a French basketball player who plays for French Pro A league club Cholet.<ref>[http://www.lnb.fr/fr/Pro-A/200006/Joueurs/A46661/Gobert-Rudy profil] www.lnb.fr  sports reference retrieved 22 November 2011</ref>

==Career==
===French youth teams===
Gobert won the bronze medal at the [[2011 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship]] and the silver medal at the [[2012 FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship]]. In the 2012 edition, Gobert was named in the All-Tournament Team together with his countryman [[Léo Westermann]].

===French league===
Rudy Gobert averaged 4.0 points (50.0% FG) and 6.0 rebounds per game in 13 minutes in the [[2010-11 LNB season]] and 4.1 points (68% FG) and 3.7 rebounds per game in 14 minutes in the [[2011-12 LNB season]] with [[Cholet Basket]].

===French national team===
Gobert was called by coach [[Vincent Collet]] to help the [[France national basketball team|French national team]] prepare for the [[Basketball at the 2012 Summer Olympics|2012 Summer Olympics]] tournament. He played 2 friendly games, scoring 8 points.

===NBA===
Rudy Gobert had initially decided to go for the [[2013 NBA Draft]] due to his position at one point leading him to a lottery selection. Gobert set [[NBA Combine]] records for wingspan (7 feet 8 1/2 inches) and standing reach (9 feet 7 inches) in the 2013 combine.<ref>[http://sportsillustrated.cnn.com/nba/news/20130614/nba-mock-draft-2013-shabazz-muhammad/?sct=uk_t11_a1] http://sportsillustrated.cnn.com/ sports reference retrieved 14 June 2013</ref>
